baseline_models.focus_anchor: Adjacent bounded plots, unlike crops and palms, one irrigation source, differential produce, and the closing appeal to reason.
baseline_models.mechanism: Spatial proximity and one supplied input hold major conditions in common while bounded plots, plant kinds, and outputs vary. The ayah therefore behaves like a controlled comparison in which unequal yield exposes causal depth beyond visible irrigation.

activation_trace.role: A separated tract supplies each bounded comparison unit.
Physical nearness holds the broad environment nearly constant.
Caused irrigation supplies the shared input rather than merely naming wetness.
Unity in one respect defines the control without erasing plurality elsewhere.
Increase or surplus makes the output asymmetry concrete.
Crop and tree yield is the observable response variable.
Discriminating restraint turns the scene into an inference rather than a glance.

changed_reading.before: A scenic list of neighboring crops watered alike yet producing differently.
changed_reading.after: A controlled comparison: common input and proximity make unequal yield evidence that visible supply is not the whole cause.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Palms from one stock and palms not from one stock are both watered by one water and still differ in produce.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah crosses two classifications, shared or separate origin and shared nourishment, then refuses to let either classification determine identical output. Kinship constrains comparison but does not cancel individuation.

activation_trace.role: Near kin from one origin supplies the relation of shared ancestry.
Shoots or palms emerging from one root make that kinship materially botanical.
Otherness and exception mark the comparison class outside shared stock.
Delivered water supplies a common nourishment channel across both classes.
Union in one aspect sharpens rather than dissolves differences of origin and yield.
Part-to-part comparison keeps plurality inside one field of relation.

changed_reading.before: A botanical note distinguishing clustered palms from separate palms.
changed_reading.after: A test of inheritance and environment in which neither common stock nor common nourishment compels duplicate outcomes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth consists of divided pieces explicitly characterized as neighboring, followed by repeated part-to-part comparison.
baseline_models.mechanism: Division creates units legible enough to compare; adjacency keeps them in contact. The ayah holds distinction and relation together, making a mosaic rather than either an undivided mass or isolated parcels.

activation_trace.role: Division and segmentation establish real boundaries among units.
Neighboring proximity prevents those boundaries from becoming isolation.
Parts remain mutually comparable within the larger whole.
Literal binding supplies a cognitive image for holding separate observations in one explanatory system.

changed_reading.before: The land is merely broken into neighboring plots.
changed_reading.after: The land is a topology of bounded contact: difference becomes intelligible because units are distinct and still relationally near.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Tree-covered gardens conceal much of their roots and soil while their produce becomes an explicit sign for reasoning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden's covering hides internal conditions; common visible water removes an easy explanation; divergent yield then becomes the exposed mark from which concealed constitution is inferred.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the system's hidden interior.
A tree-covered garden materializes that concealment in the focus scene.
Common irrigation blocks a simple visible-input explanation.
Yield provides the visible output of the covered system.
A manifest mark turns output difference into evidence.
Disciplined understanding supplies the inference from exposed result to concealed cause.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are visible scenery offered as a general sign.
changed_reading.after: Each garden is a partly opaque causal system whose fruit visibly diagnoses differences hidden below the shared waterline.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later water image adds channels that flow according to their measure. Shared supply can therefore produce unequal outcomes through the receiving unit's shape, capacity, and fitted measure, not through supply alone.

activation_trace.role: Irrigation supplies the common incoming cause in the focus comparison.
Water delivery identifies the material transmitted into each plot.
Sameness in the supply dimension isolates receptivity as a live variable.
Fit to a specific measure supplies the capacity condition governing reception.
Actual flowing water turns common descent into distributed movement through receivers.
A valley as a flood channel supplies the differently shaped receiving conduit.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats descending water, plural channels, and an explicit distributive measure before its foam and benefit contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one focus water and later channels flowing by measure. Reader arrow: receiver capacity mediates common supply into different yields. Live alternative: the focus difference is direct preference or species difference without a capacity mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Identical water is followed by an unexplained direct preference among fruits.
changed_reading.after: One supply is transformed by measure-fitted receivers, so unequal yield can disclose differentiated capacities within a common causal stream.

context_deltas.mechanism: The flood parable separates conspicuous surface excess from benefit that remains in the earth. Activated beside the palm-root image of choosing the best, preference in produce becomes a process of filtering, retention, and durable usefulness rather than bare rank.

activation_trace.role: Selection of the better supplies an internal filtering image latent in the palm term.
Comparative degree supplies the explicit evaluative operation.
Agricultural yield supplies what the filtering process finally presents.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion for what deserves retention.
Floating froth supplies visible excess that need not equal useful yield.
What is cast away supplies the rejected output of the filter.
Stable waiting and remaining supply the durable output retained in earth.

structural_cues: In 13:17 the sequence moves from repeated foam, to casting away, to benefit, to remaining in the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: transient foam departs while benefit remains, and the focus palm root carries a selection branch. Reader arrow: preferred produce is the retained result of ecological discrimination. Live alternative: preference names taste, quantity, or direct favor without filtration.

changed_reading.before: Some produce is simply better or more abundant than other produce.
changed_reading.after: The shared-water system discriminates between transient excess and retained benefit; preferred yield is what survives a material filter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated change root in 13:11 links outward communal change to change within selves. This activates the focus contrast and yield difference as potentially responsive: what common provision becomes depends partly on an interior state, not only an external input.

activation_trace.role: Changing or replacing a form makes focus difference dynamically producible rather than merely taxonomic.
Yield supplies the outward result whose variation needs explanation.
Repeated transformation supplies a two-level relation between inner and outward states.
The inward self with reason and awareness supplies the mediating interior variable.

structural_cues: The until-construction in 13:11 makes inward change a threshold for a changed communal condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: outward change is correlated with inward change, while focus plots turn one water into different yield. Reader arrow: internal constitution mediates response to shared provision. Live alternative: the social rule and botanical sign remain parallel but causally separate.

changed_reading.before: Differential yield is wholly imposed from outside despite identical nourishment.
changed_reading.after: Differentiation can also be responsive: an interior constitution helps determine what a common provision becomes outwardly.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later commands distinguish required connection from culpable cutting that corrupts the earth. The focus parcels can therefore be genuinely bounded without being severed from relation; adjacency is a maintained connection, not accidental side-by-side placement.

activation_trace.role: Segmentation supplies legitimate differentiation into bounded parcels.
Neighboring proximity supplies relation across those boundaries.
Joining one thing to another supplies the positive maintenance of relation.
Severing a bond supplies the destructive mode of cutting contrasted with bounded plurality.
Departure from sound order supplies the consequence when cutting destroys required connection.

structural_cues: 13:21 states the positive connection pattern; 13:25 reverses it as cutting followed by corruption in the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: focus has cut pieces in adjacency, while 13:21 and 13:25 oppose joining to severance. Reader arrow: healthy boundaries preserve relational flow; severance turns distinction into corruption. Live alternative: the later ethical language is only a lexical echo of geographical parcels.

changed_reading.before: The earth is partitioned into independent units that happen to touch.
changed_reading.after: Boundaries organize plurality, but flourishing depends on maintained connection; destructive cutting is a failure of relation, not distinction itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expansion and constriction of provision, followed elsewhere by spending from provision, recast unequal produce as allocation within a circulation system. More fruit marks a larger entrusted flow, not proof that its receiver has greater intrinsic worth.

activation_trace.role: Gift or benefaction supplies an allocation frame for differential yield.
An edible share or provision makes produce distributable sustenance.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the limiting side of allocation.
Breadth, increase, and surplus supply the expansive side of allocation.
Outflow through expenditure turns received provision into circulation.
An apportioned gift identifies unequal abundance as provision rather than earned rank.

structural_cues: 13:22 places spending downstream of receiving provision; 13:26 pairs expansion and constriction without assigning moral superiority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: provision is expanded or constrained and recipients spend from it. Reader arrow: focus yield differences are entrusted allocations whose social function includes circulation. Live alternative: the focus comparison remains strictly agronomic and carries no distributive implication.

changed_reading.before: Preferred produce implies a simple hierarchy of better and worse plots or plants.
changed_reading.after: Unequal yield is an allocation of sustenance within a larger flow, so abundance creates responsibility rather than certifying merit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later garden joins flowing support to produce that persists. It adds time to the focus comparison: preference may concern resilience, recurrence, and duration of nourishment, not only present quantity or flavor.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered garden supplies the shared ecological frame.
Yield supplies the focus output whose quality is being extended through time.
A promise that opens future expectation supplies the temporal horizon.
Continuing provision turns river flow into recurrent support.
The repeated yield branch directly carries the focus output into the later garden.
Stillness and duration supply persistence as a dimension of preferred fruit.

structural_cues: 13:35 coordinates flow beneath the garden, its produce, permanence, and shade in one compact sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the later garden has recurrent support and lasting produce. Reader arrow: endurance is one axis along which focus yields are preferred. Live alternative: the promised garden contrasts with present agriculture instead of explaining it.

changed_reading.before: Preference among produce concerns an immediate harvest state.
changed_reading.after: Preference may include temporal performance: recurring, resilient nourishment distinguishes one yield from another under continuing support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus noun presents parcels as a settled mosaic, but later verbal cutting of earth and diminution from its edges reactivate those parcels as snapshots of an ongoing boundary process. Edges can be made, lost, and redrawn.

activation_trace.role: A separated tract supplies the apparent stable parcel.
Active division of earth turns the parcel noun back into a boundary-making process.
Loss of part of a thing supplies contraction of the land unit.
The edge or terminal boundary identifies where that contraction operates.

structural_cues: 13:31 verbalizes cutting the earth; 13:41 depicts approach to earth together with reduction from its edges.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: focus has land pieces, later earth is cut and reduced at edges. Reader arrow: the focus mosaic is a temporary state of dynamic boundary formation. Live alternative: the later passages concern miraculous or political change without revising the agronomic scene.

changed_reading.before: The neighboring parcels are fixed, pre-existing blocks.
changed_reading.after: The parcels are temporary boundary states in a landscape whose edges are continually produced, diminished, and rearranged.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped target for the adjacency root and carries a bodily repair image into land and relation. It remains anchored in the focus pairing of cut parcels with adjacency and is reinforced by later undoing and joining language. Render only as an exploratory repaired-fracture analogy, not as the lexical translation of the focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Cut plots are not left apart; they are held immediately in neighboring relation.

activation_trace.role: Physical severance supplies the fracture that needs relational repair.
A broken member healing with residual crookedness supplies the packet-sanctioned repair image for adjacency.
Undoing a tightly made structure supplies the threat of reopening the join.
Joining separate things supplies the act that holds a fractured whole together.

changed_reading.before: Adjacent plots are independent parcels placed side by side.
changed_reading.after: The landscape can be carried as a repaired fracture: boundaries remain visible, yet functioning wholeness depends on how the separated parts are joined.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because it carries branches of segmented speech, writing, detailing, erasure, and establishment into a field. It remains anchored in the focus sequence of pieces, manifest signs, and reasoning, with context repeatedly framing signs through a book. Render with 'as if' or 'can be read as'; do not claim that land is literally text.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Earth-pieces are arranged into a sign-field whose differences must be read and bound by reason.

activation_trace.role: Segmented speech or verse supplies the analogy of plots as articulated units.
A visible mark makes each output difference legible as a sign.
Joining one element to another supplies composition of discrete units into a readable whole.
Detailing parts and meanings supplies articulation within that whole.
Removal of a trace supplies the editable or erasable side of the sign-field.
Persistence and stability supply the contrasting established marks.

changed_reading.before: The landscape supplies observations from which signs are inferred.
changed_reading.after: The landscape can be read as an articulated, revisable inscription: bounded units compose a whole, while stable and erased features alter what its yields signify.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers edible yield into epistemic reception. It remains anchored in the focus linkage of parts, produce, signs, and a reasoning people, then receives a direct contextual trigger where a faction rejects only a part. Render as a reception analogy, not as a replacement for the botanical sense of produce.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Part-to-part produce differences culminate in signs addressed to a people capable of understanding.

activation_trace.role: Partition into portions supplies the selectable units of reception.
An allotted edible share supplies the ingestion analogy.
Manifest signs supply what is cognitively received or refused.
A separated portion assigned to a group supplies selective communal uptake.
Failure to recognize or acknowledge supplies refusal of the selected portion.
The repeated part term directly activates partial rather than total reception.

changed_reading.before: Some fruits differ from other fruits in material quality.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory reception model, a sign-field can be ingested selectively: communities may take, rank, or reject portions even when they share one source.

strongest_changes: One water moved from an unexplained common cause to a stream transformed by measure-fitted receivers.
Preference in produce gained a filtering mechanism: transient excess is discarded while durable benefit remains.
Cut parcels moved from static isolation to bounded contact whose connections can be maintained, severed, or redrawn.
Unequal produce moved from intrinsic rank toward provision, circulation, temporal resilience, and an exploratory inner-to-outer feedback.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several mechanisms without collapse: controlled agronomic comparison, kinship without uniformity, receptive capacity, material filtering, relational ethics, provision, and duration. The non-dominant repaired-fracture mapping and the textual and reception outliers preserve stranger activations under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus grammar leaves open whether preference is direct, species-based, capacity-mediated, or some combination.
The social, textual, and inward-feedback readings may be contextual analogies rather than intended causal explanations of the plots.
The lasting produce of 13:35 may retrospectively illuminate present ecology or contrast it with an eschatological garden.
